profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary:
🚀 Software engineer with a passion for backend engineering, big data, machine learning, and clean code.

📚 𝗧𝗘𝗖𝗛 𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗖𝗞
➤ Programming Languages - Python, Java, SQL, Scala

➤ AWS - EC2, ECS, EMR
➤ Big Data - Apache Spark, Kafka, Hadoop
➤ Machine Learning - Python ( Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, SpaCy, Xgboost, LightGBM)
➤ Data Visualization - Tableau, Pandas, Plotly, Seaborn, Matplotlib
➤ Web Development - Flask, Node.js, HTML, CSS
➤ SQL - MySQL, SQLite, PostgresSQL,
➤ Version Control - Git, Github
➤ Containerization - Docker, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes
➤ CI/CD - Jenkins, Bogie
➤ Agile - Jira

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.insights: Apache Airflow, Anthropic Claude and +8 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a data workflow engine and orchestration platform running an implementation of Apache Airflow
- Created and supported our own suite of custom Airflow operators to interact with our internal apis and databases.
- Supported 10+ teams in creating and maintaining hundreds of Airflow DAGs (data pipelines)
- Reduced AWS costs by 40% by improving monitoring, rightsizing resources, and optimizing code.

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
Parsed information from employee resumes using natural language processing:
– Created a named entity recognizer with SpaCy to grab work history
– Used regex to retrieve personal information
– Designed a tableau dashboard visualizing key performance indicators of both specific employees and of the workforce as a whole with tableau.
– Presented final product to senior leadership and received letter of appreciation

positions.title: Climbing Instructor
positions.description: Supervised college rock climbing wall and taught climbers. As well as set climbing routes and performed wall maintenance.

projects.title: American Sign Language Detection Application
projects.description:
- Utilized Keras to create a Convolutional Neural Network to translate American Sign Language.
- Attained an accuracy of 99.26% on the ASL alphabet
- Achieved an accuracy of 91%

projects.title: Microsoft LightGBM Contributions
projects.description:
- Contributed to Microsoft's LightGBM machine learning project:
- Upgraded old code to improve speed
- Implemented type hinting to allow testing with MyPy with static typing
